_comment: Per-player skills (co-op: each player has their own). Doing the work earns XP; levels make you faster and unlock perks. xp_levels[i] = XP needed for level i+1 (level 1 = start). speed[i] = work-speed multiplier at level i+1 (timers and hold times divide by it), so level 1 is deliberately slow and level 10 is quick. repair_tiers: the fault repair_level (1-3) -> the Repair skill level needed. Perks: unlocked at `level` in `skill`; effects are read by Sim/stations via has_perk().

skills.name: Hauling
skills.desc: Carrying stock. More hands-free trips per stack, and pallet work gets easier.

skills.name: Testing
skills.desc: Diagnostics on the test bench. Faster tests and smarter bench habits.

skills.name: Repair
skills.desc: Fixing faults. Unlocks level 2 repairs at skill 4 and board-level repairs at skill 7.

skills.name: Grading
skills.desc: Honest cosmetic grading, listing photos and light refurb touch-ups.

skills.name: Purchasing
skills.desc: Buying lots. Discounts and a feel for which lots are worth it.

skills.name: Sales
skills.desc: Selling and dispatch. More buyer traffic for the whole company.
